board.note: 9x10 grid played on intersections. River divides rows 4-5. Palace zones at center columns 3-5.

horse.note: Moves one step orthogonally then one step diagonally outward. The orthogonal step must not be blocked.

cannon.note: Slides freely to empty squares. Captures by hopping over exactly one intervening piece (the screen).

soldier.note: Before crossing the river: forward only. After crossing: forward or horizontal.

check.definition: general is attacked by opponent piece
check.constraint: player in check MUST resolve check this turn

flying_general.definition: generals may not face each other on the same file with no intervening pieces
flying_general.constraint: a move is illegal if it leaves the two generals on the same file with no pieces between them

palace_confinement.definition: generals and advisors must remain within the 3x3 palace zone
palace_confinement.constraint: general and advisor moves must land in the palace (cols 3-5, rows 0-2 for red, rows 7-9 for black)

river_restriction.constraint: elephant moves must land on the same side of the river as the elephant started

elephant_blocking.definition: elephants are blocked by a piece on the intermediate diagonal square
elephant_blocking.constraint: the square diagonally between start and destination must be empty

horse_blocking.definition: horses are blocked by a piece on the orthogonal intermediate square
horse_blocking.constraint: the first orthogonal step toward the destination must be empty
